`v5-motor-world.json` was generated by the production 0.2.1 kernel at commit
`32041bce93f87eb9c10d7ea46bc3466cc1b29a50`, then compacted without changing values.
It contains balanced founder FND-005 (seven body parts), seed 73, after seven
1/60-second ticks in a zero-food world. Its 76 input and 24 output activations,
weights, hidden memory, joint state, lineage and PRNG are actual old-build data.
Tests migrate this to the six-channel controller and compare every surviving
channel by its identity, rather than synthesizing a supposed legacy layout from
the new implementation.
